classification.difficultyReason: Read the supplied endpoint coordinates, divide distance by time and attach the given units; the graphs start at the origin and require no unit conversion.

content.prompt:
Use the gradient to find the rate of change of distance over time (speed) for these graphs.
Use the units given on each graph.

spec.description: Ungrid­ded distance–time graph with positive axis arrows, labelled origin values and a marked endpoint.
spec.mathematics: Straight segment from (0,0) to (10,1000); horizontal axis t (hours), vertical axis d (km).
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and endpoint are permanent givens; the supplied speed is stored only in the answer.

spec.description: Ungrid­ded distance–time graph with positive axis arrows, labelled origin values and a marked endpoint; the segment is shallower than the neighbouring graphs.
spec.mathematics: Straight segment from (0,0) to (5,35); horizontal axis t (seconds), vertical axis d (cm).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied speed is stored only in the answer.

spec.description: Ungrid­ded distance–time graph with positive axis arrows, labelled origin values and a marked endpoint.
spec.mathematics: Straight segment from (0,0) to (8,20); horizontal axis t (minutes), vertical axis d (cm).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied speed is stored only in the answer.

spec.description: Ungrid­ded distance–time graph with positive axis arrows, labelled origin values and a marked endpoint; the horizontal axis extends beyond the endpoint.
spec.mathematics: Straight segment from (0,0) to (2,98); horizontal axis t (minutes), vertical axis d (mm).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied speed is stored only in the answer.
